title: Networking Fundamentals
tagline: Eight Cisco Packet Tracer exercises on network devices, protocols, the OSI model and Linux networking tools.
summary: A networking project made of 8 exercises in Cisco Packet Tracer. I built and configured networks with different device types, worked with core protocols and services, placed them in the OSI model, and practiced Linux networking commands.
problem: DevOps work needs a clear picture of how data moves between machines. This project builds that picture from the ground up, one exercise at a time.
